## 2. Power-factor correction

- Qc = P (tan phi1 - tan phi2) = 576.8 x (0.6302 - 0.3287) = **173.9 kVAR** -> select **175 kVAR APFC panel (7 x 25 kVAR steps)**
- After correction: 606.8 kVA, PF **0.951**
- Line current at 415 V: 948 A -> 844 A (**11.0 % less current, 20.8 % less I2R loss** in cables)
- Transformer copper loss: 5.81 kW -> 4.60 kW = 8694 kWh/year saved
- Illustrative bill impact: demand charge Rs 4.27 lakh/yr; if billed in kVAh, Rs 40.5 lakh/yr (tariffs in CFG are assumptions)

## 3. Transformer sizing (with 20 % future margin)

| Case | Load kVA | Required kVA | Standard rating |
|---|---|---|---|
| Without correction | 682 | 818 | **1000 kVA** |
| With correction | 607 | 728 | **800 kVA** |

Selected: **800 kVA, 11/0.433 kV, Dyn11, %Z = 5.0**. Loading 76 % today.

## 4. Fault level at the 415 V bus (per-unit, base = transformer rating)

- Z_source = 0.80 MVA / 250 MVA = 0.0032 pu; Z_transformer = 0.0500 pu; total 0.0532 pu
- I_base = 1067 A -> grid in-feed fault current **20.1 kA** (15.0 MVA)
- Motor contribution ~4 x FLC = 4.2 kA -> total **24.3 kA** -> specify switchgear for **36 kA**

## 5. Relay settings and grading (IEC 60255 curves)

| Relay | Location | Curve | CT | Plug setting | Pickup (A, primary) | TMS | Time at max fault |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | 415 V outgoing feeder to cooling-tower MCC | EI | 300/1 | 100 % | 300.0 | 0.34 | 0.068 s |
| R2 | 415 V transformer incomer (ACB) | SI | 1250/1 | 115 % | 1437.5 | 0.15 | 0.388 s |
| R3 | 11 kV transformer feeder (VCB) | SI | 75/1 | 85 % | 63.8 | 0.26 | 0.705 s |

- Grading margins at 20.1 kA: R2-R1 = 0.32 s, R3-R2 = 0.32 s (required >= 0.3 s, checked at every current)
- Motor-start check: R1 sees 573 A during a fan DOL start and would need 10.3 s to trip > 8 s run-up -> **no nuisance trip** (why R1 uses the Extremely Inverse curve)
- R3 instantaneous high-set: 1026 A on 11 kV (1.3 x max LV through-fault), clears 11 kV-side faults fast
